native.definition: Pressure925–300hPa; per-step q*u, then Gregorian and same native footprint aggregation. Land variables use identical observed-rain land pixels with >=80% native area coverage; reference and modeled925hPa must be above ground. No fallback for empty masks.
limitations: Observed q*u is product of monthly reanalysis means, missing submonthly covariance.
Two-box model q and wind are piecewise constant in pressure; no resolved vertical momentum or energy.
WorldClim rain and NCEP climatology have different observational periods and construction.
These reused development regions and new Mexico fields are diagnostics, not independent held-out validation.

plan.purpose: Six diagnostic-only reruns of two saved climates; no new parameter choice, calibration, objective, or adoption.
plan.diagnostic_decision: Exploratory process attribution only: compare actual inflow/return, dry donor exchange, storm redistribution and rain components before choosing one subsequent hypothesis. No diagnosis alone counts as improved rainfall or independent validation.
plan.exactness: Every original climate NPZ field including legacy native vectors must be bit-exact. Actual params and case hashes identical. Sidecar equations/rain reconstruct; precise per-step water/rain cast to float32 must match result buffers. All33 primer/scored steps recorded, scored days identical.
plan.fixed_background_scope: Inherited WorldClim cloud and remote monsoon background fields remain fixed; conditional regional solver, not fully independent global forecast.

recovery.purpose: Recover tuple/list comparison failure, without changing physics, old sources, results or masks.
recovery.controller_failure: In-memory asdict parameter tuples compared with saved JSON lists; no changed parameter values or climate arrays. Original two saved cases verify after JSON canonicalization.
